chunks: And Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated this hadith also from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"The month of Ramadan is thirty days, it never decreases." Then he mentioned from another chain with words that add and subtract from what was previously mentioned.
ai.seo_question: How many days are in the month of Ramadan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to establish the definitive thirty-day duration of Ramadan, a ruling that resolves discrepancies between lunar sighting and calculation. This fixed count is crucial for Shia jurisprudence in determining the exact start and end of fasting, distinguishing it from months that may vary between twenty-nine and thirty days.
